title: Raccoon waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- raccoon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#8B7D9B'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='12' ry='13' fill='#B8AFC4'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='22' fill='#9B8DAB'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='30' r='9' fill='#7A6C8A'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='30' r='5' fill='#C4A9B0'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='30' r='9' fill='#7A6C8A'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='30' r='5' fill='#C4A9B0'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='18' ry='10' fill='#4A3F5A'/>
  <!-- lighter mask inner shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='15' ry='8' fill='#5D506E'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='48' r='5' fill='#2A2233'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='47' r='2.5' fill='#F0E6FF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='48' r='5' fill='#2A2233'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='47' r='2.5' fill='#F0E6FF'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#D4C8D8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#3A3040'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 59 Q50 62 54 59' stroke='#6A5A70' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left arm (down) -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='80' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#8B7D9B' transform='rotate(20 28 80)'/>
  <!-- right arm waving up -->
  <g transform='rotate(-40 72 70)'>
    <ellipse cx='72' cy='62' rx='6' ry='12' fill='#8B7D9B'/>
    <!-- paw -->
    <circle cx='72' cy='52' r='6' fill='#4A3F5A'/>
    <!-- paw pads -->
    <circle cx='69' cy='50' r='2' fill='#C4A9B0'/>
    <circle cx='75' cy='50' r='2' fill='#C4A9B0'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='55' r='2.5' fill='#C4A9B0'/>
  </g>
  <!-- waving motion lines -->
  <path d='M82 42 Q86 38 84 32' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M86 46 Q91 43 90 38' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M79 38 Q81 33 78 29' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail stripes -->
  <path d='M20 90 Q10 80 15 68 Q18 62 14 56' stroke='#7A6C8A' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M20 90 Q13 82 16 72' stroke='#4A3F5A' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='95' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#4A3F5A'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='95' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#4A3F5A'/>
</svg>
